project.policyNote: What you write here is given as written to every agent working in this project.
project.policyStart:
## Project purpose
- Let the user learn how to use alpacawork by trying it out.

## Ask the user first
- For a change that affects how something looks or feels to use, show a sample and ask before building it.
- Ask before starting work that changes direction or will take a long time.
- Get approval before publishing, sending anything to outside services or people, replacing a running service, doing anything that costs money, or deleting something that cannot be restored.

## Decide without asking
- For anything not listed above, decide without asking, go ahead, and report the result.

## How to work
- Except for small fixes, when the work is done, have the work checked by an AI other than the one that made it, fix what it finds, and then ask the user to review it.
- For a screen design change, have a separate AI create each candidate, up to three in total. The owner shows them to the user together and asks which one they prefer. When asking, the owner also says which one it recommends and why.

## Not allowed
- Do not write secrets such as API keys or passwords in records or deliverables.

alpacawork-betterquality.cost: Results get better, but the checks add time and token usage. The number of checks depends on how heavy the work is; for light work, the agent checks its own result.
alpacawork-betterquality.what: Agents set the pass criteria before work starts, and another AI checks the result before you are asked to review it.
alpacawork-betterquality.when: when planning, when asking for a review, and when receiving findings

askmeclearly.what: Agents keep questions and reports short and mark where to look in images or video, so you can decide and check quickly.
askmeclearly.when: when asking the user to decide, and when writing a report

doyourjob.what: Agents look up what they can and decide what they may, so they ask you only what you alone can decide.
doyourjob.when: before asking the user, and before making a choice with large consequences

skills.lead: Used with alpacawork, these skills make tasks easier to hand off. Agents ask only what needs your decision, write reports that are easy to check, and deliver better results.
